title: Repeal of The Sindh Land Revenue Amendment Act 2011

sections.shortTitle: Repeal of The Sindh Land Revenue Amendment Act 2011
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XI OF 2011
ORDINANCE XI OF 2011
REPEAL OF THE SINDH LAND REVENUE
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2011 (SINDH ACT
NO.XXIII OF 2011), ORDINANCE, 2011
An Ordinance to repeal the Sindh Land Revenue
(Amendment) Act, 2011
[Gazette of Sindh
Extraordinary, Part I,
7th August, 2011]
No.S.LEGIS:1(11)/2011, dated 7-8-2011.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:--
Preamble.---
Whereas it is expedient to repeal the Sindh Land
Revenue (Amendment) Act,
2011, in the
manner hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the Provincial
Assembly is not in session and the Governor is satisfied that circumstances
exist which render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now,
therefore, in exercise
of the powers
conferred by clause (1) of
Article 128 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, 1973, the
Governor is pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:--
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Repeal of Sindh Land Revenue (Amendment) Act, 2011 (Sindh Act No.XXIII of 2011)
Ordinance, 2011.
(2) It shall come into force at once and shall be
deemed to have taken effect on and from 9th July, 2011.
